external_steps: IM4P payloads were decompressed earlier with an external IM4P tool; the decompressed files are hashed here, not re-derived
The device tree payload was converted to JSON earlier with an external tool; this run parses the binary payload directly

aic.translation_source: first /arm-io ranges entry containing the AIC window

claims.statement: The restore archive holds 127 entries, and 0 erase components are missing from it
claims.limitation: Listing only. Entry contents were not read or decompressed

claims.statement: 26 of 32 manifest digests match the local file; 6 do not: Ap,RestoreSecurePageTableMonitor, Ap,RestoreTrustedExecutionMonitor, RestoreDCP, RestoreDeviceTree, RestoreKernelCache, RestoreSEP
claims.source: manifest Digest (SHA-384) compared with the local file of the same path
claims.limitation: The mismatching entries name the same path as a non-restore entry. The reason for the difference is not established

claims.statement: 4 components carry a keybag and are not analysed: RestoreSEP, SEP, SepStage1, Yonkers,SepObject
claims.source: IM4P keybag element of each local file
claims.limitation: The keys are not in the restore archive. No decryption was attempted

claims.statement: 4 erase components state no file path in the manifest: ftap, ftsp, rfta, rfts
claims.limitation: Without a path they cannot be located in the archive. Their content is not established

claims.statement: The kernel payload is a Mach-O arm64e MH_FILESET image with 264 fileset entries
claims.source: decompressed kernel payload, Mach-O load commands
claims.limitation: Header and load commands only. No code was analysed

claims.statement: The device tree has 379 nodes; its root compatible is D84AP, iPhone16,2, AppleARM
claims.limitation: Static template. Values that iBoot fills at boot are not present

claims.statement: The AIC node has compatible aic,3 and 1 interrupt cell(s)
claims.limitation: The one-cell convention is Apple's (see the kernel diagnostic claim)

claims.statement: The AIC window translates to 0x2d1000000 through the first /arm-io ranges entry
claims.source: device tree /arm-io/ranges and /arm-io/aic reg, cell widths from the nodes
claims.limitation: The arithmetic is established. Whether iBoot maps the window there is not

claims.statement: The Ghidra project file is empty and no function export exists
claims.source: Ghidra project file and repository index
claims.limitation: Index presence only. No function counts or cross-references were computed
